analysis:
Examined added Gemma4TensorParallelPagedSession.swift (head 1-313) and Gemma4TensorParallelPlan.swift (head 1-433); Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix.swift only as metadata plus the file_changes excerpt (full source not in this batch).

Plan: config parsing validates the model type, tied head, MoE, k_eq_v, positive integers, affine 4/8-bit quantization and group sizes, and per-layer overrides. cut/localShape bound ranks and ranges. No trust-boundary surface.

PagedSession: prefill/decode guard the frontier, retirement, vocabulary range and page reservation (lines 118-119, 150-151, 180-183). Batch decode requires distinct open sessions of one model. retire is idempotent and checks isClosed. generatePaged retires the session on failure and checks host.isDrained (line 309).

The restore path (lines 74-85) adopts a QwenStagePrefixState after a geometry check (Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix.adopts). The prefix capture (lines 136-138) feeds Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix.

The Prefix excerpt describes a memory tier plus an optional encrypted SSD tier (QwenStagePrefixDiskTier). Keys are built from the load agreement, the chunk grid and the plan scope, in a tenant partition (ClusterWorkerPrefixCache.scope), with cross-rank sealed-sum votes.

This is a new cross-tenant prefix/at-rest surface in darkbloom-cluster, relevant to T-041/SEC-035 and A-001. T-041's mitigations reference provider-swift KVCacheSSD, HMAC lookup tags, coordinator-authored cacheSalt, the 30-minute TTL and the kill switch.

Integration must verify in Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix.swift and its callers:
- the tenant scope derives from the authenticated coordinator cacheSalt, not caller input;
- SSD names and metadata use keyed tags, not raw prefix hashes;
- the TTL and DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate apply;
- the inter-rank vote channel is authenticated/encrypted, so a peer rank cannot cause adoption of wrong state.

Inter-rank collectives carrying FP32 activations (Plan lines 27-31) also expose A-001-derived data across hosts. Their transport protection is outside the supplied evidence, and the threat model lacks a cluster boundary. No concrete regression was identified in the visible code.
